description: This file defines the class GenericGrainDirectoryResolver, which implements the IGrainDirectoryResolver interface. It provides functionality to resolve grain directories based on grain types within the Orleans runtime, utilizing dependency injection to obtain necessary services.

classes.name: GenericGrainDirectoryResolver
classes.description: Implements IGrainDirectoryResolver to resolve grain directories based on grain types, using dependency injection for service resolution.

methods.name: TryResolveGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the grain directory for a given grain type and properties, returning true if successful.

methods.description: Retrieves the GrainDirectoryResolver instance, initializing it if necessary.
